message.content: {"caption":"Agent archive tree and SWE-bench score progress for DGM without self-improvement.","description":"The composite figure has an agent archive tree on the left and a three-series line chart on the right. The tree is titled “DGM w/o Self-improve Archive Tree.” Its circular nodes contain small agent ID numbers; many are too small to read clearly. Node fill color encodes SWE-bench score on a vertical scale from 0 to 0.5, ranging from dark blue at the bottom to yellow at the top. The legend identifies red node borders as agents evaluated on 10 tasks (no basic functionality), orange borders as 60 tasks, and green borders as 200 tasks (score ≥ 0.4 and among the archive’s top two). A star marks the final best agent. Thin lines connect nodes in a branching tree, with branches extending from upper/root nodes toward offspring below and to the sides; no arrowheads or connection labels are visible, and some lines are darker than others.\n\nThe right panel, titled “DGM w/o Self-improve Progress,” plots SWE-bench Score against Iterations. The x-axis runs from 0 to 80 in steps of 10; the y-axis spans 0.15 to 0.50 in steps of 0.05. The olive line, “Average of Archive,” starts near 0.20, rises to about 0.225 early on, falls to roughly 0.21, rebounds near iteration 25, and then stays close to 0.22. The green “Best Agent” line rises from about 0.20 to 0.28 near the start, remains around 0.28 until about iteration 24, then rises to about 0.39 and stays there. The dark “Lineage to Final Best Agent” series connects its marked points from about 0.20 to 0.28, dips to 0.27, and then reaches about 0.39.
